project_info.theme: TNGA chassis rigidity and journey stability
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, Cyan Neon, Red, White, Urban Gray, Green

main_subject.detail: A red Toyota Corolla Cross drives along a multilane roadway while the lower body becomes semi-transparent to reveal the chassis, suspension, and undercarriage structure highlighted with glowing cyan lines around all four wheels.
main_subject.style: Photoreal engineering-feature automotive poster combining realistic car photography with translucent technical cutaway visualization.

items: Top Left: White Toyota logo on blue sky.
Top Center: Cyan gradient headline bar 'KHUNG GAM TNGA' and large white subheadline 'VUNG TU CAU TRUC, ON DINH TREN HANH TRINH'.
Bottom Left: Road lanes and tree line moving past the vehicle.
Bottom Right: Handwritten white 'Move your world'.
Center/Background: Red Corolla Cross with transparent lower body exposing chassis and suspension hardware, blurred city skyline, and glowing cyan engineering outlines.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Bright daylight with technical visualization glow
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean automotive daylight, subtle motion blur, translucent body effect, precise cyan edge lighting on undercarriage components, crisp engineering readability.

assets.name: TNGA chassis cutaway visualization

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The undercarriage reveal must feel like a premium technical explainer, not a crude X-ray effect. Keep the upper body realistic and the chassis detail readable, with cyan glow used only to trace the engineering system and wheel connection points.
